description: Sprouts Data Intelligence lets users search a B2B contact and company database, review matches in an interactive widget, and act on them: set up an Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) to filter and rank results, enrich a contact's phone and email from a LinkedIn URL, move selected contacts or accounts into the Sprouts CRM, check credit balance, and manage query templates, search history, and refinement preferences.
